Commentary.Commentary: Leg gully and short mid-wicket in place now...

So, target for Bangladesh is a massive 457! The Lankans have got too much in the bank which will allow their bowlers some freedom. After gaining a huge 182-run lead, the Lankans have done a fab job on the back of a fluent ton from Tharanga and then some handy contributions from others to swell it to a mammoth one. The Bangladesh bowlers lacked venom although their spinners got some turn. The tourists have their task cut out. We saw some turn today which might only make matters worse for the visitors. They have to apply themselves as they need to bat out for 4 sessions. Will the visitors' openers once again provide a superb start or will SL continue to march on? Join us in a bit for the chase...

OUT! Slow off cutter around middle, Perera looks to cut it away but gets a feather through to Das who takes an easy catch. Huge appeal for caught behind and Perera starts to walk away as well. Herath in the balcony signals his batsmen to come back to the dressing room. Finally, SRI LANKA HAVE DECLARED.
Good length outside off, Perera gets back and dabs it towards point.
11th Test fifty for Chandimal. First after eight innings, so a welcome return to form for the Lankan vice-captain.
Short and outside off, Chandimal gets back and cuts it away through point for a single.
Slow cutter around leg stump, dabbed towards gully on the bounce.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and defends it towards cover.
Back of a length outside off, rocks back and blocks it to the covers.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN is back.
Herath, who was padded up till now, has removed his protection and other batting gear. Some of the other Lankan players seem ready as well to take the field. The declaration isn't far away.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and pushes it to cover.
50-run stand between Chandimal and Perera!
FOUR! Perera is having some fun! Floated on middle, Perera clears his front leg and goes down on one knee to swing it over mid-wicket to find the fence.
Flatter on middle and leg, raps Perera on the pads. Stifled appeal for lbw.
Flatter on a length outside off, gets back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Flatter outside off, gets back to punch but gets a bottom edge to the off side.
Short on middle and leg, Chandimal swivels and pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Almost chopped on. Fullish and around off, Perera looks to dig it out but gets a thick inside edge just past leg stump down to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Another boundary! Clever from Dilruwan as he gives himself room and glides a shortish ball over backward point as the ball races to the fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Clean strike! Back of a length around off, Chandimal clears his front leg and clobbers it over mid-wicket. The ball races away to the fence for a boundary.
Dug in short around leg stump, Perera swivels to pull but misses as the ball goes down the leg side to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal glides it fine towards third man for a single.
Fuller around off, gets across and pats it down to long off for a single.
Flighted outside off, leans forward and pushes it to the off side.

FOUR! Finds the fence! Floated from outside off, Chandimal gets well across to that one and sweeps it hard through backward square leg. Terrific shot and the fielder in the deep had no chance of cutting it off.
Flighted outside off, leans into it and pats it towards cover.
Nicely looped around off, Perera pushes at it but gets an inside edge to square leg for a single.
Floated from outside off, Chandimal gets well across and sweeps it behind square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
SHAKIB AL HASAN to bowl from the other end.
Floated from outside off, Chandimal gets well across and sweeps it behind square of the wicket on the leg side for a single.
Some issue behind the bowler as there is some movement near the sightscreen.
Good length outside off, gets the stride forward and blocks with the full face of the bat.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and drives it towards cover.

Length ball closer to off, Chandimal shuffles across to work across the line but is rapped on the pads. Stifled lbw appeal but the impact was outside the line. Height was the issue as well, perhaps an inside edge too.
Good length angled in around off, steered towards point with an angled bat.
Back of a length outside off, pushed off the back foot towards cover.

Welcome back for the final session. The weather seems good and that might be the reason why Sri Lanka didn't declare before tea. But surely, they have enough runs in the bank now. Herath doesn't feel so, yet. TASKIN AHMED to bowl the the first over after tea.
.....DAY 4, SESSION 3.....

Another session pocketed by Sri Lanka. There was definite intent after lunch by the hosts as they rattled up 160 runs from the 31 overs bowled at the cost of four wickets. Tharanga helped himself to a century while the others all threw their bat around with Chandimal eyeing a half century. There was a bit more turn on offer for Shakib and Mehedi this session which shows the pitch is slowly breaking up. No declaration yet and it's already overdue. Strange! Join us in a while for the final session.
Full and outside off, Perera gets on the front foot and drives it straight to the cover fielder. TEA ON DAY 4!
Quicker one around middle and leg, goes back and flicks it towards short mid-wicket.
Full and around off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Short again and outside off, dabbed off the back foot towards backward point for one.
FOUR! Drops it short and outside off, Dilruwan camps back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Flayed! Short and outside off, Perera makes the most of it. He cuts it through cover-point for a boundary. That raced away!
Short and outside off, Chandimal cuts it behind point for one.

Fuller in length and just around off, Chandimal comes forward and drives it towards covers. Dinesh initially jogs towards the other end but then he realizes there is another one on offer. Two added to the total.
Top edge! Short and outside off, Perera flashes hard at it but gets a top edge down to third man. It bounces just before the fielder there and they pick up a single.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Perera sits under it.
Fuller and right into the blockhole, Dilruwan digs it out.
TASKIN AHMED is back into the attack! Dilruwan has taken extra protection with the chest guard coming in.
Lunges well forward and drives it through covers for one.
Flatter one around off, pushed back to Shakib.
DR comes down the track and nudged it towards mid on.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards covers.
Gets down and sweeps it from outside off to deep backward square leg for a single.
Short and outside off, Perera cuts it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Full and fired on the stumps, Perera looks to jam it towards the leg side but gets it off the inner half towards backward square leg for one.

SAFE! This one skids through the surface, very close to the off stump, Dilruwan comes forward to defend but misses. The keeper collects and whips the bails off. They appeal and it's taken upstairs. Replays show the batsman was easily in.
Stumping appeal referred upstairs. Dilruwan seems to be safe.

SIX! In the air... dropped! Loops it up around middle, Perera comes down the track and hoicks it across the line. Gets good connection but Mahmudullah in the deep is quick to get to his left. He tries to take it with a reverse cup but the ball bursts out of his hands and then parries over the rope for a biggie.
Full around off, defended off the front foot.
DILRUWAN PERERA is the next man in!

OUT! What a catch! Liton Das, you beauty! Mehedi floats it up outside off, Dickwella once again opts for the reverse sweep but this time the keeper anticipates it. Das moves to his left and the ball comes straight to him as he brings out his left hand and the ball sticks. Looks even better in the replays! Wonder when will SL declare, they already lead by 404!
FOUR! Full and outside off, Dickwella nails the reverse sweep past first slip for a boundary to start the over. Declaration batting?
Full and drifting in from around off, Chandimal prods forward and defends it back to Shakib.
FOUR! Drops it short on middle, Chandimal gets low in the crease and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary. LEAD IS NOW 400!
DC lunges forward and defends it by keeping his bat and pad together.
Dances down the track to this full ball and hits it down to long on for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Chandimal opens the face of the bat and glides it towards short third man for a single.
Full around off, jammed back to the bowler.
Floated around off, Chandimal plays the reverse sweep to deep backward point for a single.
Fuller on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single.
SIX! CLOBBERED! Floated on off, gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it cleanly over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. Struck it well and cleared the ropes with ease.
Floated outside off, sits on the back foot and defends it solidly.
Flatter outside off, gets back and punches it to the off side.
Floated around off, Dickwella mistimes the reverse sweep towards short third man.
On middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.
Pushed quicker through the air around off, Chandimal looks to reverse sweep this time but misses and gets hit on the pads. A shout for an LBW but maybe, the impact was outside the line.
Full around off, pushed towards covers.
Niroshan shimmies down the track and clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Darts it in from around off, swept towards backward square leg.

NOT OUT! Umpire's call! Shakib tosses it up around off, it turns in a bit, Dickwella gets down to reverse sweep but misses and is hit on the arm-guard. Bangladesh appeal hard and long but the umpire turns it down. They take a review. Replays show it was in line and would have gone on to clip the top of leg stump. Still, not a bad review this from the visitors!
An appeal for LBW against Dickwella is taken upstairs!
Flatter one around middle and leg, clipped behind square on the leg side for a double. Good running!
Skips down the track but flicks it straight to short mid-wicket.
Tossed up around middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
swept behind square on the leg side for a single.
Quicker through the air around off, Dickwella looks to defend but is lucky as the ball goes just past the outside edge.
Ouch! Loopy ball around off, Dickwella gets down to sweep but the ball goes off the forearm and hits the grill of the helmet. He takes his helmet off and the physio is out to attend him.
Lunges forward and defends it down gently.
Flattish around the stumps, flicked to mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up around middle and leg, swept straight to short fine leg.
Comes down the track and works it towards short mid-wicket.
NIROSHAN DICKWELLA is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! What a ball! Drifting in from around off, slightly round arm action, Gunaratne looks to defend but the ball straightens a bit, beats his defense and crashes into the stumps. Shakib doesn't celebrate as this is not an important wicket in the context of the match.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.

Yes he has! This one spins down the leg side, Gunaratne gets down to sweep but misses. Liton behind the stumps collects it by moving to his left and dislodges the bails as the batsman tries to gets back in. They refer it upstairs and replays show Asela's bat was in the air but he did well to drag it back in time.
They are going upstairs for a stumping against Gunaratne. Seemed to be okay in normal motion. Has he got his bat down in time?
Sliding down the leg side, Gunaratne leaves it alone.
ASELA GUNARATNE is the new man in.

OUT! Mehedi strikes! Drifting in from around off, Upul Tharanga gets down to sweep but misses the line and the ball goes on to crash the timber. Tharanga has to walk back, but, boy, what a knock this has been from him! Sri Lanka lead by 381 runs!
Flighted ball around off, Tharanga gets down to sweep but gets beaten as the ball turns away.
FOUR! What a hit! Loopy ball around middle, Upul reverse sweeps it over point this time. A couple of bounces and he gets another boundary. Toying with the field is Upul!
FOUR! Ahh. lovely! Tossed up outside off, Tharanga nonchalantly lofts it over extra cover and picks up a boundary.
Full outside off, Chandimal leaves it alone.
Drops it a touch short, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker through the air around middle, Upul comes down the track to hoick it through the leg side but gets hit on the body.
50-run stand between Tharanga and Chandimal!
SIX! Boom! Now he will up the ante! Gets a tossed up delivery, runs down the track and nails the loft over long on for a biggie.
Slower around off, punched down to long off for a single.
3rd Test hundred for Upul Tharanga!

Upul Tharanga, well played! Full and around off, Tharanga flicks it off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end. No real celebration from him. Just a raise of a bat, and that is it!
Tossed up outside off, Tharanga takes a long stride forward and pushes it towards point for a single. On 99 now!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gets behind the line and defends it down.
Tossed up well outside off, UT reaches out to that one and drives it towards covers where Mominul dives to his right to stop that one.
Comes forward and keeps it out gently.
Full around off, Tharanga brings his pad and bat together in defense.
Short and flat outside off, punched off the back foot towards mid off.
Floats it up outside off, driven towards mid off for one.
Flatter through the air around middle, clipped towards short mid-wicket.
Loopy ball around off, bunted back to Shakib.
Full outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
FOUR! Gets it fine! Tossed up around off, Chandimal gets low and across to paddle it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Darts it on the pads, nudged towards mid on for one.
Loopy ball around leg, worked towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Chandimal comes forward to defend but the ball goes off the pads and lobs towards mid-wicket.

A loud shout for lbw, turned down! Floats it up around middle and off, Dinesh gets down and once again attempts a reverse sweep. Misses and is hit on the pads. Mehedi appeals for an LBW but the umpire shakes his head.
On middle and leg, worked towards the leg side.
Gives it a nice flight around middle, Chandimal gets down and reverse sweeps it through cover-point for a couple.
Tossed up around off, driven towards covers for nothing.
Tossed up outside off, UT takes a stride forward and drives it towards point for a couple.
Comes in sharply as Tharanga defends it down gently.
Bowls it down the leg side as Upul misses his flick. The keeper fails to collect and they take twos bye. LEAD GOES PAST 350!
Loops it up around the pads, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Chandimal lunges forward and pushes it towards backward point for a single.
Slower and around off, Upul goes back, opens the bat face and glides it past short third man for a brace.

Edged but safe! Mehedi tosses it up outside off, Chandimal prods forward to defend but gets a thick outside edge towards first slip where Sarkar crouches low to his left to take the catch but the ball goes off his left boot and runs further. A single taken.
On middle and leg, milked down to long on for a single.
Loopy ball around off, pushed towards Mominul at covers.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to short extra cover.
Short and outside off, dabbed behind point for a couple.
Drinks break!
Flighted outside off, leans forward to block but gets it off the inside half of the bat down the track.
Flatter on middle, gets back to pull it away but mistimes it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy and outside off, reaches out and defends it solidly.
Fuller outside off, leans into it and defends it solidly.
Fuller and outside off, leans across and whips it away down to long on for a single.
Fuller outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.

Was that a chance? Flighted outside off, nice off break and Tharanga is lured into the drive. The ball spins away sharply and goes off Das' glove past first slip. We will have to get another look at that one to confirm.
Flatter and outside off, Tharanga cuts it away through point for a couple.
Floated on middle and leg, worked towards square leg for a single.
Fuller and outside off, Tharanga eases it to cover for a run.
What was that? Out of frustration, Chandimal goes for the reverse sweep. Doesn't make contact and the ball goes off the pads towards fine leg. Stifled lbw appeal but turned down.
Full and around off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Loopy and around off, Chandimal leans across and pushes it towards mid off.
Flatter and arrowing in on middle, backs away and slaps it to short cover.
Tossed up around off, Chandimal makes room and pushes it towards mid off.
Tossed up outside off, presses forward and blocks it solidly to the off side.
Loopy on middle and leg, Chandimal works it towards short mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, leans forward and blocks solidly.
Flighted outside off, presses forward and pushes it towards short cover.
Flatter on middle, too close to cut but Tharanga goes through with the stroke. Chops it towards backward point.
On middle and leg, Chandimal clips it towards square leg for  a single.
Full and outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Floated off break from around the wicket, Tharanga pushes at it but gets it off the outer half to cover for a single.
Floated on middle and leg, worked with the turn through backward square leg for a single.
MEHEDI HASAN is back.
Drifting in on a length from outside off, Chandimal taps it towards the off side for a single.
Full and outside off, driven down the ground to long on for a single.
Flatter on the stumps, Chandimal gets back and whips it away through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and defends it solidly.

FOUR! SUPERB SHOT! Flatter around leg, a touch short and Chandimal rocks back in a flash. Whips it away stylishly wide of the mid on fielder for a boundary. Excellent stroke and Dean Jones on air reckons that this is the shot of the match.
Tossed up around off, gets across and whips it away down to long on for a single.
Length ball angled in from around off, gets across and pats it back to the bowler.
Good length outside off, gets back and blocks it solidly.
Back of a length angled in from around off, Tharanga glides it down to third man for a single.
FOUR! HAMMERED! This time Tharanga nails the pull comfortably and puts away the half-tracker easily to the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Back of a length outside off, punched off the back foot square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
In the air... lands safe! Dug in short outside off, Tharanga goes for the pull but mistimes it high towards deep mid-wicket. Falls safe as the batsmen get a single.
Slider on middle, Chandimal makes room and crunches it towards cover.
Fuller and on off, Chandimal blocks it back to the bowler.
DINESH CHANDIMAL is the new man in, replacing Mendis! Slight delay as the close-in fielders are taking their time to get all the protection in place.

OUT! GONE! Mendis falls to his favorite stroke in pursuit of quick runs. Floated on middle, he goes for the mighty slog sweep but skews it high towards deep mid-wicket where Taskin takes an easy catch. No heroics from him this time around but the Lankans don't need it either. LEAD BY 316.
Deft touch! Floated around middle, Tharanga gets across to play a premeditated paddle. Off the toe end but well down the leg side past Das as it rolls towards fine leg. Three runs taken.
Full on middle and leg, worked away to the leg side.
Floated around off, leans forward and clips it towards square leg.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.
Back of a length on middle, tucked to the leg side for a single.

FOUR! SMASHED! Drags it short around off, Tharanga stays back and wallops the pull wide of mid on. Made terrific contact and the ball raced away to the fence in no time. The charge is certainly on now from the Lankans.
Shortish outside off, stands tall and crashes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and pushes it towards cover.
Good length on off, angling in, pushed off the back foot to mid on.
SUBASHIS ROY is back on.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks solidly.
Fuller on middle, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
50-run stand between Mendis and Tharanga.

SIX! Smashed! Mendis and his slog sweeps pack a punch always, don't they? Drifting in from around off, he gets down on one knee and lifts it mercilessly over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. Clean strike!
Floated on middle, Mendis works it towards mid-wicket.
Floated on off, Tharanga whips it away down the ground to long on for a single. LEAD IS 300 NOW.
Full and outside off, Tharanga pushes at it but gets an edge to short third man.
Good length around off, Tharanga gets across to push at it but gets an inside edge that goes down to fine leg. They take a single.
Good length around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
FOUR! Gets lucky! Length ball outside off, stuck a bit off the deck as Tharanga goes for the flashy drive but gets a thickish edge that flies uppishly to the third man fence for a boundary.
Full and outside off, pushed towards cover.
Slower ball but slips it down the leg side, Tharanga misses the flick.
Length ball outside off, Tharanga looks to cut but gets a bottom edge on to the ground.
Loopy and outside off, reaches out and defends it solidly.
Flighted on middle, stays back and pushes it towards cover.
Floated on middle and off, turning in, Mendis works it with the turn to the leg side.

Slight mix up but safe in the end. Floated around middle, nudged towards the short fine leg region. The leg slip fielder gets across to stop it as the batsmen have a slight stutter while going for the single. All is well eventually as the run is taken just in time.
Loopy and outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Flatter outside off, punched off the back foot towards cover for a single.

FOUR! More runs! This is in his favorite zone. Short and wide outside off, Tharanga latches on to it and slams the cut through backward point. Gets it away very fine and the third man fielder cannot get to the ball as it gets to the fence.
FOUR! Smashed! Back of a length outside off, Tharanga punches it sweetly between extra cover and mid off. Timed it brilliantly and the ball raced to the fence for a boundary.
Mistimed stroke but falls safe! Fuller ball outside off, Tharanga looks to go downtown but miscues it completely. Manages to clear mid off though and gets a brace.
Good length closer to off, defended solidly from the crease.
7th Test fifty for Tharanga.
Slower ball and outside off, punched square of the wicket on the off side for a couple. Neat little knock and he will want to score a few more runs to build on his confidence in the longer format.
Full and outside off, crisply driven to the right of Mustafizur who stretches to his right in his followthrough to make the stop.
Flighted on middle and off, Tharanga clears his front leg and hammers it down the ground to long on for a single. Moves to 49.
Quicker ball on middle, Mendis nudges it towards short mid-wicket and they steal a quick single. The throw at the bowler's end was very wild but luckily for the visitors, no overthrows.
Tossed up around off, gets across and whips it away down the ground to long on for a single.
Flatter and fuller on the stumps, Tharanga pushes it towards mid on.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped gently towards the leg side.
Floated around middle, Tharanga gets across and sweeps it towards backward square leg off the toe end.
Edged but doesn't carry! Mustafizur gets another cutter to grip from around leg, angling across Mendis who pushes tamely at it. Gets the outside edge but it falls just short of Das.
Slower ball outside off, Mendis leans forward and pats it towards cover.
Good length outside off, Tharanga gets back and guides it towards backward point for an easy single.
Fullish cutter and outside off, tailing in a touch, Tharanga looks to block but the ball grips off the track to hit him high on the bat.
Tharanga tries the dab again but this time the gully fielder makes a good stop.

FOUR! Smartly done by Tharanga! Not the right ball to bowl with this field as Mustafizur drops it short and wide outside off, the southpaw just uses the pace and glides it just past a diving gully fielder to find a boundary.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN to bowl from the other end.
It's gone dark at one end of the ground, quite similar to how it was before tea yesterday. There is a bit of sun on the other side but the weather clearly isn't encouraging.
Flatter on middle and leg, worked through square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, this one grips a bit off the track and spins into Tharanga who looks to block. The ball flies off the inside half of the bat but doesn't carry to short mid-wicket.
Looped up from outside off, Tharanga pushes it gently towards cover.
Flighted outside off, driven through the covers for a single.

NOT OUT! Flatter and around leg stump, Mendis gets down on one knee to sweep as Das collects it well down the leg side. Delayed appeal for caught behind that then picks up steam as all the players join in. The umpire is unmoved and so Rahim opts for the review. Remember that there is no Hot Spot or Snicko for the series and so the third umpire will have to depend totally on the visuals and any audible sound. After taking numerous replays,  S.Ravi feels that there isn't any conclusive evidence to overturn the on-field call. Not a surprising decision considering the lack of detailing in technology. This is why DRS looks a joke when used in this way, a handicapped feature.
Bangladesh have taken a review for caught behind against Mendis. Seemed a delayed yet confident appeal from Das.
Tossed up on the pads, Tharanga clips it through mid-wicket for a single.

Welcome back for the second session. Let's see what approach the Lankans will come out with. Nothing much Bangladesh can do except to play the waiting game. SHAKIB AL HASAN to start proceedings after lunch. A slip and a leg slip in place.
.....DAY 4, SESSION 2.....

Another session to the Lankans. The openers stitched a solid stand to thwart whatever little hopes Bangladesh might have harbored of a comeback. Taskin broke the stand when he removed Karunaratne but Tharanga has stood firm with first innings hero Mendis. The Bangladeshi bowlers have looked uninterested and hardly had a plan in place. The lead is now 269 and all eyes will be on when Herath declares, given the rain forecast predicted for today and tomorrow. Will there be more intent after lunch? Join us in a short while for the second session to find out.
Flighted around the stumps, Kusal Mendis pats it back to the bowler. LUNCH ON DAY 4!
A loopy full toss around middle and leg, swept straight to the man at backward square leg.
Loopy ball around off, Tharanga leans into it and drives it past a diving cover fielder for a single.
Slower one around off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Floats it up around off, driven towards mid off for nothing.
Tossed up outside, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around off, Mendis defends it by lunging forward.
Comes forward and blocks it out.
Darted in on the stumps, played back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket.
Tossed up around off, pushed off the front foot towards covers.
Bowls a slider around off, turning in, it's defended firmly.
Tharanga brings his bat and pad together to defend it down.
Loopy ball around off, bunted back to Hasan.
Drops it short again, Kusal goes deep in the crease and cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Short around off, crunched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Floats it up around middle and off, Tharanga defends it by covering the line.
MEHEDI HASAN is back on!
Loopy ball around the leg stump, clipped behind square on the leg side for a single.
Drifting in on the pads,  UT misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Tossed up around middle, nudged towards mid-wicket.
On middle and leg, Tharanga flicks it straight to square leg.
Short and outside off, punched it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Full and flat outside off, Kusal comes forward to let it be.
Short of a length ball, coming in with the angle, Upul arches back to evade it.
Fires in a yorker on the base of the off stump, Tharanga jams it out towards the man at gully.
Fuller in length and angling in on the pads, bunted towards mid on.
Good length outside off, Kusal comes forward to defend but gets an outside edge which rolls behind point for a single.
Touch short and served outside off, Mendis looks to poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Good length ball on off, defended with a straight bat.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks solidly.
Drifting in from around off, defended well from the crease.
Flatter on middle, stays back and pulls it towards square leg.
Slightly short around off, stays back and punches it towards cover. Single taken.
Flatter around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Short of a length ball outside off, Tharanga looks to play the ramp shot but fails to get any bat on it as the ball bounces a bit more.
Short outside off, pulled straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Comes from around the wicket this time and serves it on the leg stump, flicked in front of square leg for one.
Back of a length ball on middle, Kusal covers the line and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Taskin Ahmed comes running in but loses his rhythm at the last moment and hence doesn't deliver...
Back of a length ball outside off, the batsman plays inside the line and is beaten this time.
Short of a length ball outside off, Mendis goes back and tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Very full on the stumps, it's jammed out by Upul.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around the pads this time, flicked towards square leg.
Full around middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
Floats it up outside off, Mendis looks to drive but gets it off the outer part of the bat towards backward point for a single.
Tossed up around off, Mendis comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Fuller in length and angling in, Tharanga looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Back of a length again, around off, UT looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads.
FOUR! Upul with a pull here! Back of a length ball on middle, Tharanga swivels and pulls it in front of square to pick up a boundary.
Beaten again! Good length delivery, in the channel on off, Upul hangs his bat around and is beaten again.
On a length and in the channel outside off, Tharanga pokes at it as the ball whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Comes from around the wicket, bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, he ducks to evade it.
Once again Shakib drags his length short on off, punched past covers for a single.
Drops it short on middle, pulled to deep square leg for one.
Gets forward to this loopy ball and keeps it out.
Floats it up around off, defended into the ground.
Gets forward and defends it on the leg side.
Tossed up outside off, driven hard but straight to short extra cover.
Shortish in length and just outside off, Mendis hops and dabs it towards backward point for a single to get off the mark.
Fuller on off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Wide! Taskin hits the deck hard, Kusal just lets it watch over him to the keeper. Wide called!
Outside off, left alone by Kusal.
No ball! Shortish around off, Mendis punches it towards the off side. Taskin oversteps and a no ball is called for the same.
Angles in a length ball from around off, Mendis decides to shoulder his arms.
KUSAL MENDIS is the new man in.

OUT! Got him! Taskin bangs in a short ball on middle, it kicks off the deck and cramps the batsman for room. Karunaratne still goes for the pull but doesn't bother to keep it down as the ball goes towards deep mid-wicket. Mahmudullah from square leg comes to his right and takes a good catch. Bangladesh get a breakthrough this morning, SL lead by 251!
Angles it away from the batsman who pushes it towards covers.
Flatter one around off, defended by covering the line.
FOUR! Crunched! Drops it short and outside off, enough time for Tharanga to go back and pack the punch through extra cover. The fielder gives it a chase but it never looked like he would cut it off.
Tossed up on the stumps, defended off the front foot gently.
Loops it up around off, nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball around off, driven along the ground through covers for a single.
Floats it up around middle and off, Dimuth gets down and reverse sweeps it past the first slip fielder for three runs.
Drifting on the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Length ball, angling in on the pads, tucked through square leg for a single.
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Tharanga ducks to let that one sail over him to the keeper.
Good length ball around off, punched off the back foot past Mominul at short extra cover for a single.
Fuller in length and angling in, pushed towards mid on.
Back of a length ball around off, defended off the back foot towards covers.
TASKIN AHMED is called into the attack now, replacing Mustafizur!
Short and around off, punched to deep point for an easy brace.
Goes back and ounches it towards the right of the bowler.
Tossed up around off, Tharanga comes forward to defend but the ball turns in sharply and raps him on the pads. A loud appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Pushes it quicker through the air around off, Dimuth taps it towards covers for a quick single.
FOUR! Reverse swept! Shakib bowls a loopy low full toss outside off, Dimuth gets into the position early and reverse sweeps it off the meat of the bat through backward point for a boundary.
Floats it up around off, it straightens a bit, Karunaratne comes down the track to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge past first slip for a couple.
SHAKIB AL HASAN is asked to roll his arm over!
Back of a length ball, served outside off, Tharanga once again opts for the cut shot but it goes on the bounce to gully. That's 4th maiden in a row for Rahman!
Fuller in length and around off, pushed with soft hands towards covers.
Short and outside off, UT looks to cut but it goes straight to the man at gully.
Silly mid on in place now...
Fuller and slower in pace around off, Tharanga defends it down.
Fuller in length and well outside off, Upul looks to defend but gets beaten.
Back of a length and outside off, Tharanga stays back and pushes it towards point.
Drinks time at Galle!
The slider around off, Karunaratne gets back to cut but is beaten as that skids through off the pitch.
Speared in on middle and leg, easily worked past mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, Tharanga gets forward and taps it to the off side.
Slightly short and outside off, Karunaratne stays back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it past cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle, gets across and jams it towards short mid-wicket.
Almost a nick! Full and outside off, slower ball at 115 kph, Karunaratne pushes at it but is beaten by the off cutter.
Fuller on off, gets across and clips it firmly to short mid-wicket.

Big appeal! Full and around off, shapes in sharply to rap Karunaratne on the pads. Loud lbw appeal, turned down. Probably did too much off the surface. Replays confirm an inside edge too, good decision by the umpire.
Full and around off, Karunaratne pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller around off, leans across and pushes it towards mid on.
Full and outside off, presses forward and blocks it towards cover.
Fuller outside off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Slightly short outside off, Tharanga rocks back and cuts it to the off side.
Floated on a length outside off, stays back and dabs it to the off side.
FOUR! Fab shot! Tossed up around leg, steps out and makes room to loft it straight down the ground to the long off fence for a boundary.
Loopy outside off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Floated around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and blocks it solidly down the track.
Shortish and wide outside off, Karunaratne flashes at it but misses.
On middle and leg, gets across and clips it to mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, reaches out and blocks it solidly to cover.
Fuller on middle, gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Good length outside off, gets back and dabs it to point.
Quicker ball outside off, Karunaratne rocks back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a run.
Flatter outside off, gets back to that one and blocks it solidly.
Slightly short outside off. Dimuth gets back to cut but gets it off the edge towards point.
Drifting in from around off, defends it solidly from the crease.
Full and outside off, leans into it and blocks it solidly. Single to mid off.
Flatter outside off, sits back and punches it firmly to sweeper cover for a single.
Full and around off, leans across and pushes it towards mid on.
Full and outside off, comes in a bit with the angle, Tharanga does well to block solidly.
Full and outside off, leans into it and pushes it towards the off side. It came off the outer half of the blade.
Length ball outside off, leans into it and pats it towards cover.
Fine yorker on middle and leg, Tharanga gets across and manages to dig it out.
Good length angled in from around off, Karunaratne stays back and blocks solidly.
Full and around off, presses forward and blocks well. Maiden from Mehedi.
Drifting in from outside off, Dimuth pats it towards point.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and defends solidly.
Flatter outside off, sits back and taps it to point.
Darted in from around off, Karunaratne gets back and pushes it to short cover.
Flatter on a length outside off, gets back and pats it towards short cover.
Good length around off, solidly blocked from the crease.
On a length angled in from around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Back of a length outside off, Karunaratne gets back and blocks it solidly.
Full and outside off, leans forward and pushes it towards cover.
Good length closer to off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Good length angled in around off, gets across and blocks it solidly.
MUSTAFIZUR RAHMAN comes on to bowl.
Fuller and outside off, leans forward and blocks it solidly.
Floated around off, Tharanga pushes at it but gets an inside edge on to the pads.
Floated around off, Tharanga premeditates the paddle and scoops it uppishly towards short fine leg. First slip gives chase to keep the batsmen down to two.
Fuller and outside off, presses forward and blocks well.
Almost a catch! Floated outside off, Karunaratne reaches to play the drive but mistimes it. Mehedi dives to his right but cannot reach the ball. Great effort. Single to mid off.
Flighted nicely outside off, Tharanga leans forward and drills it through the covers for a single.
Good length angled in from around off, Tharanga pushes it through point for a run to keep strike.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and clips it through square leg for a single.
Shortish around off, gets across and blocks solidly on to the track.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and pushes it to point for a single.
Nicely timed! Length ball outside off, Karunaratne eases the drive past mid on. It won't make the fence but the batsmen will get three.
Back of a length outside off, Karunaratne defends it solidly off the back foot.
Full and outside off, leans forward and blocks solidly.
Flighted and around off, reaches out and pats it towards cover.
Flatter and angled in around off, defended solidly off the front foot towards cover.
SIX! POSITIVE BLOW! Flighted outside off, Tharanga charges down the track and lofts it cleanly over wide mid off. Made terrific contact and the ball went all the way for a biggie.
Fuller and outside off, reaches out and pushes it towards cover.
Floated outside off, Karunaratne taps it to point for a single.
Shortish outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Back of a length outside off, stays back and
Five Wides! That's gone over everyone! Short ball from Roy but it's too high and even a leaping Das cannot get a hand on it. Bonus runs to the total. LEAD GOES PAST 200.
Back of a length outside off, the line from Roy has been too wide to make the batsmen play.
Good length slanting away well outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
Dug in short, the line is down the leg side and so Karunaratne ducks with ease.
On middle and leg, Tharanga looks to flick it away but is struck on the pads.
Very full and around off, Tharanga digs it out to the covers. Mehedi has been too full so far and needs to find the right length to create pressure.

DROPPED! Tough, tough chance. Tossed up around off, Karunaratne uses his feet and powers it to sweeper cover for a single. Shakib at short cover got a hand to it but he needed luck to take a catch of that magnitude, it was struck too hard.
Floated outside off, Karunaratne is once again solid in defence.
On a length outside off, Dimuth reaches out and taps it towards point.
Flatter and outside off, Karunaratne gets forward and blocks it solidly.
Flighted outside off, pushed gently towards cover for a single.
Good length outside off, sits on the back foot and defends well.
Length ball around off, Dimuth defends it solidly by getting right behind the line.

Poor from Tamim! Good length around off, jabbed off the back foot towards mid-wicket. Tamim fires a wild throw and cannot blame Rahim for not getting it, he would have had to be at least two feet taller to get a hand on it. The batsmen get a couple of runs off the overthrow.
Back of a length around off, Karunaratne hangs back to block but gets high on the bat.
Good length on off, stays back and defends it solidly to the leg side.
Had to hurry! Back of a length around off, pushed off the back foot towards mid off and they scamper through for a single. Good running.
Flighted very full on off, Tharanga thumps it down the ground towards sweeper cover for a single.
Floated around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Quicker ball outside off, gets back and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted outside off, reaches out and blocks solidly.
Slider outside off, Karunaratne stays back and pats it towards short cover.
Full and around off, leans across and pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
Good length around off, Tharanga defends it solidly from the crease.
Length ball in the zone around off, defends it well from the crease.
Back of a length outside off, blocked solidly off the back foot.
Short of a length outside off, stays back and punches it to sweeper cover for a brace.
Back of a length outside off, hangs back and blocks firmly.
Length ball around off, Tharanga defends it solidly from the crease.
Pushed through quicker from outside off, blocked solidly off the front foot.
Drifting in from outside off, gets forward and pushes it gently towards mid off.
Tossed up outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
Beaten! That one grips a bit. Flatter and around off, skids through after pitching as Tharanga is beaten on the push.
Flatter around off, blocked solidly from the crease.
Tossed up very full around middle, Tharanga pushes it back to the bowler.
MEHEDI HASAN to share the new ball.
Strays on the pads, neatly worked through mid-wicket for a brace. Erratic first over from Roy.
On middle and off, Karunaratne is solid in defence.
Keeps it well outside off, that's another easy leave for Karunaratne.

The edge squirts through! Fuller around middle, Dimuth looks to work across the line but gets a leading edge that gets through the slip cordon towards third man. Good effort by the fielder in the deep keeps the batsmen down to two.
Another length ball outside off, Karunaratne lets it pass.
Good length outside off, no stroke offered to that one.
